limits: No personal browser profile or formal knowledge approval.
Negative storage fixtures and setItem faults exist only in disposable contexts.
Ordinary rejection must not become global owner lock; genuine persistence faults must remain visible.
Mock provider intentionally emits no research events. Nonempty event fixtures come from legal synthetic expectation forms; healthy watch tasks come from an explicit overdue review date.
